description: Implement webhook receiver endpoint POST /webhooks/{webhook_id} with signature verification and provider-specific parsing. The receiver looks up webhook config, verifies signature using secretRef, extracts payload data via provider parser or JSONPath mapping, builds flow context, and triggers the configured flow.
steps: 1. Create engine/internal/webhook/provider.go with Provider interface (VerifySignature, ParseEvent, ExtractEventType) and types: WebhookEvent (Type, Payload, Headers, RawBody), SignatureParams (Header, Algorithm, Secret). Define provider constants.

2. Create engine/internal/webhook/stripe.go implementing Provider for Stripe: verify using Stripe-Signature header + HMAC-SHA256 with t=timestamp,v1=signature format, parse event envelope, extract type from $.type.

3. Create engine/internal/webhook/github.go implementing Provider for GitHub: verify using X-Hub-Signature-256 header + HMAC-SHA256 (sha256=signature format), get event type from X-GitHub-Event header, pass payload through.

4. Create engine/internal/webhook/generic.go implementing Provider for generic HMAC: configurable header name + algorithm (sha256/sha1), signature format (raw hex or prefixed). Default to X-Webhook-Signature header.

5. Create engine/internal/webhook/mapping.go with MapPayload function: takes raw payload + mapping config (map[string]string where key is ctx path like 'ctx.eventType' and value is JSONPath like '$.type'), returns map[string]any for flow context. Use a JSONPath library (github.com/PaesslerAG/jsonpath or similar already in go.mod).

6. Create engine/internal/webhook/filter.go with MatchesFilter function: takes parsed event + filter config (map[string][]string where key is JSONPath and value is allowed values), returns bool. An empty filter matches all.

7. Create engine/internal/httpapi/webhook.go with: webhookReceiver struct holding store, interpreter, deps, secretProvider; webhookHandler returns http.HandlerFunc for POST /webhooks/{webhook_id}. Handler flow: parse webhook_id from path, get webhook config from store, resolve secret via secretProvider, get provider parser, verify signature, parse/extract event, check filter, build flow.Ctx with mapped payload, run interpreter on configured flow.

8. Update engine/internal/httpapi/server.go NewHandler to mount webhookHandler on 'POST /webhooks/{webhook_id}' with rate limiting but WITHOUT operator auth (public endpoint). Pass deps.Conns secret provider to webhook receiver.

9. Add Webhook receiver specific error handling: 401 for bad signature, 404 for unknown webhook_id, 400 for unparseable payload, 500 for internal errors. Log webhook invocation via store.LogWebhook (redact sensitive payload fields).

10. Add unit tests in engine/internal/webhook/*_test.go for each provider's signature verification and parsing. Add engine/internal/httpapi/webhook_test.go for receiver handler tests using fake store.
acceptance_criteria: POST /webhooks/{webhook_id} accepts any JSON payload without auth
Stripe signature verification works with Stripe-Signature header format (t=timestamp,v1=sig)
GitHub signature verification works with X-Hub-Signature-256 header
Generic HMAC verification is configurable (header name, algorithm)
Filter blocks events not matching configured criteria and returns 200 (ack without trigger)
Mapping extracts JSONPath values into flow context under configured keys
Flow is triggered with mapped context when signature valid and filter matches
Webhook invocation is logged with redacted payload
findings: Used tidwall/gjson (already in go.mod as indirect dependency) for JSONPath extraction instead of PaesslerAG/jsonpath. Added GetActiveFlowByID method to PgStore to resolve flows by ID (webhooks store flow_id, not route pattern). Added SecretProvider() method to registry to expose secrets for webhook signature verification. Webhook handler mounts via MountWebhookHandler called from NewHandler when WebhookStore and SecretProvider are available.
